constraints.name: fk_pc_policy_version
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, pricing_policy_id, policy_version) REFERENCES pricing_policies(company_id, id, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: pricing_policies_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_pricing_policies_immutability
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_pricing_policies_immutability BEFORE UPDATE ON pricing_policies FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_pricing_policies_immutability()

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_pricing
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_pricing BEFORE UPDATE ON pricing_policies FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_pricing_policies
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_pricing_policies BEFORE UPDATE ON pricing_policies FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: idx_pricing_policies_active
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_pricing_policies_active ON public.pricing_policies USING btree (company_id, status) WHERE (status = 'ACTIVE'::text)

indexes.name: pricing_policies_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pricing_policies_pkey ON public.pricing_policies USING btree (id)

indexes.name: uq_pricing_policies_company_id_version
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_pricing_policies_company_id_version ON public.pricing_policies USING btree (company_id, id, version)

indexes.name: uq_pricing_policies_version
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_pricing_policies_version ON public.pricing_policies USING btree (company_id, version)
